put.description: Explicit metadata-only connection check. Requires CSRF and current privacy-version acknowledgement. Sends stored credentials to the approved provider destination to read model metadata; never sends health data or a prompt. Client UUID is account-scoped. Repeating the same UUID and payload replays the recorded result for at least 24 hours; reusing it for a different connection/configuration conflicts. Check claim is durable before network I/O. An interrupted claim is never retried automatically. New checks require a new UUID. At most 10 checks/minute and 100 retained checks/account; results expire after 24h on new checks. Model discovery does not establish generation, streaming, tool or structured-output capabilities.
